subject: 海事保險英文公證報告

essays.text:
請解釋下列專有名詞。（每小題 6 分，共 30 分）
① valued policy
② time policy
③ off-hire survey
④ constructive total loss
⑤ Lien Clause

請將下列海事專有名詞翻譯成中文或英文。（每小題 5 分，共 30 分）
①罷工條款
②明示擔保
③延滯費
④ Stowaways
⑤ Forwarding charge
⑥ Log book

請將下列海事英文翻譯為中文。（每小題 20 分，共 40 分）
① BunkersIf bunker fuels supplied do not conform with the mutually agreed specification(s) orotherwise prove unsuitable for burning in the Vessel’s engines or auxiliaries, theOwners shall not be held responsible for any reduction in the Vessel’s speedperformance and/or increased bunker consumption, nor for any time lost and any otherconsequences.
② Loading/Discharging - Costs/RisksThe cargo shall be brought into the holds, stowed and/or trimmed, tallied, lashed and/orsecured and taken from the holds and discharged by the Charterers, free of any risk,liability and expense whatsoever to the Owners.（請接背面）
